create_traj_follower: create a TrajFollower instance with default or custom DictConfig for trajectory following control
update_trajectory_callable: update the TrajFollower trajectory with a callable that returns desired state, derivative, and done flag
forward_velocity_command: call forward on TrajFollower with current xyt pose and time to get linear and angular velocity commands
check_traj_done: check if the TrajFollower has finished executing its current trajectory using the is_done method
review_feedback_controller: review the TrajFollower feedback controller PI control logic for computing velocity commands from pose error
